scenes.heading: Building passive income alongside client work

sents.d: Building passive income alongside client work
Templates, presets, and digital products can add income that doesn't scale linearly with your hours.

Selling design templates, presets, or digital assets (on marketplaces or your own site) creates income that isn't directly tied to more client hours — unlike client work, a template can sell repeatedly after being made once.
Starting small — turning one type of asset you already make well for clients into a polished, sellable template — is a lower-risk way to test demand than building an entire product line upfront.
This works best as a supplement to client work, not a replacement, especially early on: passive income typically takes real marketing effort and time to build to a meaningful level.

take: Turn one asset you already make well into a product.
